documents.name: Rotem Sela Background
documents.source: Rotem Sela is a prominent Israeli actress, model, and social activist with a large and engaged Instagram following. She is known for her roles in Israeli films and TV series. Rotem gained widespread international attention in 2019 when she publicly challenged then-Prime Minister Benjamin Netanyahu on Instagram regarding his statements about Arab citizens of Israel. Her post received a response from Netanyahu and went globally viral. She is outspoken about equality, democracy, and human rights in Israel. Rotem is a fashion icon and regularly collaborates with Israeli and international fashion brands. She uses her platform to raise awareness about social causes including LGBTQ+ rights and women's equality. She starred in the popular Israeli series and has appeared in various theatrical productions. Her style is elegant yet approachable. She is a mother and occasionally shares parenting reflections while maintaining strong personal boundaries. Rotem is considered one of the most influential women in Israeli public life.
